summary.business_type: E-commerce (eight one-of-a-kind hand-turned pens, CAD, ships within Canada)
top_findings: No refund, shipping or terms policy (A1)
Two pen names mean other things in search (A6)
No custom domain; brand name shared with three other pen makers (A5, B1)
quick_wins: Five relative URL redirects for deleted collections (A3)
Unpublish the 'Home page' collection; hide Blog until a post exists (A4)
Home title and meta description that say what is sold (A5)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works:
Canonicals correct on all 23 HTML pages incl. variant, filter and /collections//products/

paths
Server-rendered: raw and rendered home text identical

findings.title: Four policy pages return 404; shipping page is 'coming soon'
findings.description: /policies/refund-policy, shipping-policy, terms-of-service and contact-information return 404 (TECH-01).
findings.recommendation: Write the policies in Shopify admin > Settings > Policies with the client's facts (A1).

findings.title: Deleted collections 404 without redirects
findings.description: burl-wood, resin, bestsellers, new-runs and limited were public for six days (TECH-02).
findings.recommendation: Add relative 301s in Online Store > Navigation > URL redirects (A3).

findings.title: JS-only links between pens, from a robots-blocked URL
findings.description: 'You may also like' loads from /recommendations/products, disallowed in robots.txt (TECH-05).
findings.recommendation: Render related pens in Liquid (A10).

findings.title: Home page balloons to ~83,000 px in a tall render
findings.description: Constellation and parallax lengths are in viewport units; later sections land 47,800-81,300 px down (VIS-01, VIS-02).
findings.recommendation: Cap the lengths in px and unpin very tall viewports (A13).

findings.title: No Search Console or Bing Webmaster property
findings.description: No property exists in the connected account (TECH-12).
findings.recommendation: At the domain switch: Search Console Domain property (DNS), then Bing import (B3).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: The maker's story gives real first-hand experience

findings.title: Placeholder reviews make false claims
findings.description: Three invented cards labelled 'Customer reviews' cite Lisbon and Leeds, a gift box and a repeat buyer; repeated on the home page and all 8 pens (CONT-05, SXO-03, GEO-08).
findings.recommendation: Switch both review sections off until real reviews exist, or remove the false specifics (A2).

findings.title: Product pages miss buyer facts
findings.description: No dimensions, weight, writing system or refill type on any pen; 161-270 words; shared closing paragraph (CONT-07, CONT-10, SXO-04).
findings.recommendation: One content pass per pen with a quotable opening sentence and a five-line spec list (A7).

findings.title: Two pen names mean other things in search
findings.description: 'date seed pen' = plantable seed pens; 'leather pen' = pen cases (SXO-01).
findings.recommendation: Add 'date palm seeds' and 'layered leather' to SEO title, meta description and first sentence (A6).

findings.title: Thin collection pages and no gift guide
findings.description: Collection descriptions are 10-17 words; gift queries want a guide (ECOM-08, SXO-06, SXO-07).
findings.recommendation: 60-120 words per collection; make /collections/gifts a short guide (A8).

findings.title: Maker's credentials stated but never shown
findings.description: About page claims are unnamed and unsourced (CONT-09, GEO-06, SXO-09).
findings.recommendation: Add one or two checkable specifics or a workshop photo (A9).

findings.title: Home title and description say only the brand
findings.description: Title 'Pegasus Pens', description 'Handcrafted luxury pens'; six pages have no meta description; /collections/all is titled 'Products' (CONT-01, TECH-06, SXO-05).
findings.recommendation: Name the object, place and maker in the home title and description; fill the six descriptions (A5).

findings.title: Home h1 is the header wordmark
findings.description: The hero headline is an h2 (VIS-03, CONT-03).
findings.recommendation: Make the first slide's heading the h1 on the home template (A14).

findings.title: Collection titles don't contain 'pens'
findings.description: Generic collection titles (SXO-06, ECOM-08).
findings.recommendation: SEO titles that say what each collection is (A5).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Product + Offer on all 8 pens
No review markup for the placeholder reviews

findings.title: Organization markup is sloppy
findings.description: Eight empty sameAs strings, no logo, url becomes the page URL on /pages/* (SCH-02, SCH-03, SCH-04, GEO-02).
findings.recommendation: Replace the block in sections/header.liquid with the dynamic snippet in findings/schema.md (A11).

findings.title: No SKU, shipping or return data on Product
findings.description: No identifiers; policies don't exist (SCH-05, SCH-06, ECOM-04).
findings.recommendation: SKUs in admin; shipping and returns via Merchant Center after A1 (A15, B4).

findings.title: Collection pages have no breadcrumbs
findings.description: templates/collection.json lacks pegasus-breadcrumbs (SCH-09).
findings.recommendation: Add breadcrumb markup to collections (A15).

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CDN image formats, srcset and lazy loading on product images

findings.title: Hero (LCP) image unprioritised and oversized
findings.description: Mobile lab LCP 9.7 s; pegasus-scene.liquid drops fetch_priority; one 1145x1526 file drawn ~400 px (PERF-01, PERF-11).
findings.recommendation: Pass fetchpriority through and ship 2-3 widths with srcset (A12).

findings.title: Mobile CLS 0.318 from the announcement bar
findings.description: The bar shrinks from two lines to one when the font arrives (PERF-02).
findings.recommendation: Fix the bar's mobile height; metric-matched fallback fonts (A12).

findings.title: Fonts download twice
findings.description: Preload URL has ?v=, CSS url() does not: ~168 KB duplicate per page (PERF-03).
findings.recommendation: Make the URLs match; drop the unused preconnect (A12).

findings.title: Product page LCP 4.9 s on mobile
findings.description: No priority hint on the main photo (PERF-04).
findings.recommendation: fetchpriority=high on the first product photo (A12).

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed; text server-rendered
Shopify's UCP profile, agents.md, llms.txt and WebMCP adapter present
0 unnamed controls in the accessibility tree

findings.title: Brand name shared with three other pen makers
findings.description: Etsy 'PegasusPens', UK Facebook pages, a California maker; pegasuspens.com is for sale (GEO-01).
findings.recommendation: Tie the name to Vancouver, Mehdi and the materials everywhere; choose the domain with this in mind (A5, B1).

findings.title: Agents can't find shipping or return terms
findings.description: agents.md lists only the privacy policy (AGT-02, GEO-04).
findings.recommendation: Write the policies (A1); Shopify adds them to agents.md.

findings.title: Search indexes still show placeholder copy
findings.description: Bing/Yahoo describe burl, laminated and resin pens (GEO-03).
findings.recommendation: At the switch: Bing Webmaster, sitemap, recrawl (B3).

findings.title: AI crawler policy is Shopify's default
findings.description: Nobody chose it (AGT-03).
findings.recommendation: Optional robots.txt.liquid with named groups (A16).

categories.name: Images
what_works: Product images use CDN formats, srcset and sizes

findings.title: Bundled scene photos served at full size
findings.description: No srcset on theme-asset scenes (PERF-11).
findings.recommendation: Ship width variants (A12).

findings.title: 95 KB emblem PNG drawn at ~52 px on every page
findings.description: PERF-12.
findings.recommendation: Serve a small WebP (A12).

phases.name: Phase 1: Trust floor
items: A1 Write the refund, shipping and terms policies and the shipping-returns page
A3 Redirect the five deleted collections
A4 Take the 'Home page' collection and the empty blog out of the index

phases.name: Phase 2: Say what we sell
items: A6 Disambiguate the date seed and leather pens
A7 One content pass per pen with specs

phases.name: Phase 3: Theme work
items: A10 Server-rendered links between pens and a sold-pen state

phases.name: Phase 4: At the domain switch
phases.timeframe: When the custom domain goes live
items: B2 Make it primary and verify the handle redirects
B3 Search Console Domain property and Bing
B4 Merchant Center and free listings
